notes.title: Froworld for Free!
notes.content:
After a lot of consideration, I've decided to make [i]Frogworld[/i] free to play for the duration of the Early Release. This price change will occur on Steam as soon as it as been approved by the store.

While I was originally hoping to use the proceeds from my sales to continue development of the app, I've decided that it is more important at this stage to focus on getting as much feedback as possible from players. As a solo indie dev, that means making this prototype as accessible as I can to as many people as possible.

To all of you who purchased [i]Frogworld[/i], please know that your support has meant the world to me and will go towards the continuation of the NatureSims series! 

To all the future players out there, welcome! This is just the beginning :-)

Thank you!
Kai

notes.title: Frogworld - 0.9.1.2 Update!
notes.content:
[h1]BIG update for Frogworld! [/h1]

Many thanks to everyone who has tried the game and/or provided feedback!

Version 0.9.1.2 includes: 
[list]
[*] Improved weather simulations and environments in scenes 1 & 2
[*] Performance improvements (particularly on the Default/Low quality setting)
[*] Addition of carpenter ants in scene 2
[*] Misc bugfixes
[/list]

More updates are coming! While the game is getting closer to completion, there is still a lot of work to do, particularly on Scene 3. 

[h2]Stay tuned for more![/h2]
